Place of work: Hirslanden Corporate Office | Home Office Occupation by appointment Type of employment: Permanent Reference number: 71086 Hirslanden stands for first-class, responsible and individual health care that puts people first. From birth to old age as well as from prevention to healing – at any time, physically and digitally – the Hirslanden Group is concentrating on the further development of the “Continuum of Care” together with private and public partners. As a Mergers & Acquisitions specialist, you play a central role in shaping and implementing the Group’s strategic growth agenda through impactful transactions and partnerships. You lead the identification, evaluation and implementation of M&A opportunities on the buyer and seller side and contribute directly to long-term value creation and strategic expansion. • Your profile - University degree in finance, economics, business administration or a related field from a prestigious university - At least 3 years of professional experience in investment banking, M&A, corporate finance or transaction consulting (experience with one of the “Big 4” is an advantage) - In-depth knowledge of financial modeling and business valuation as well as practical experience in transaction processing Sound knowledge of M&A processes, due diligence frameworks and deal structuring - Experience in the healthcare sector is a great advantage fluent knowledge of English and French (at business level); Knowledge of German is an advantage Strong analytical mindset with a structured, entrepreneurial and results-oriented approach Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills in a fast-paced, transaction-driven environment Are you ready to start in an innovative environment?With us you can fully develop your strengths, know-how and competencies.
